# Branch
> Mobile measurement, attribution, and deep linking platform for apps, web, and cross-channel user journeys.

Branch provides privacy-safe linking and measurement infrastructure for mobile growth, including deep links, attribution, engagement, QR codes, ads measurement, and developer tooling for app and web integrations.

## Documentation
- [Docs Home](https://help.branch.io/): Main documentation hub for Branch products, setup, integration, and troubleshooting.
- [Branch Developer Hub](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/): Entry point for developer documentation, SDKs, APIs, and implementation guides.
- [Help Center](https://help.branch.io/): Product documentation and support content for marketers, developers, and analysts.
- [Release Notes](https://help.branch.io/release-notes/): Product and platform updates across Branch features, SDKs, and tooling.
- [Branch University](https://help.branch.io/branch-university/): Educational resources and guided learning for using Branch products effectively.

## Deep Linking
- [Deep Linking Overview](https://help.branch.io/docs/deep-linking-overview): Overview of Branch deep linking concepts, routing, and user experience flows.
- [Create a Deep Link](https://help.branch.io/docs/create-a-deep-link): Guide to creating Branch links for app, web, and campaign use cases.
- [Universal Links](https://help.branch.io/docs/ios-universal-links): Configure and troubleshoot iOS Universal Links with Branch.
- [Android App Links](https://help.branch.io/docs/android-app-links): Configure Android App Links and Branch deep link routing behavior.
- [Journeys](https://help.branch.io/docs/journeys): Web-to-app banners and prompts that drive app opens and installs.
- [QR Codes](https://help.branch.io/docs/qr-codes): Generate and manage QR codes powered by Branch deep links.

## Attribution and Measurement
- [Attribution Overview](https://help.branch.io/docs/branch-attribution-overview): Introduction to Branch attribution models, touchpoints, and measurement concepts.
- [Mobile Measurement Partner](https://help.branch.io/docs/mobile-measurement-partner): Branch MMP capabilities for install and re-engagement attribution.
- [Ads Overview](https://help.branch.io/docs/branch-ads-overview): Measurement and optimization features for paid advertising campaigns.
- [SKAdNetwork](https://help.branch.io/docs/skadnetwork): iOS SKAdNetwork support and configuration for privacy-centric attribution.
- [SAN Integrations](https://help.branch.io/docs/self-attributing-networks): Setup guidance for self-attributing network measurement with Branch.
- [Web-to-App Attribution](https://help.branch.io/docs/web-to-app-attribution): Measure journeys from web sessions into app installs and opens.

## APIs
- [API Overview](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/reference/overview): Overview of Branch APIs, authentication, and common integration patterns.
- [Deep Linking API](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/reference/deep-linking-api): Programmatically create, read, and manage Branch links and link data.
- [Quick Links API](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/reference/quick-links-api): Manage reusable Quick Links for campaigns and marketing workflows.
- [QR Code API](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/reference/qr-code-api): Create and customize QR codes backed by Branch links.
- [Ads API](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/reference/ads-api): Access advertising measurement and campaign-related Branch endpoints.
- [Webhooks API](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/reference/webhooks): Configure webhook-based event delivery and downstream integrations.

## SDKs
- [SDK Overview](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/docs/sdk-overview): Overview of Branch SDK options for mobile, web, and cross-platform apps.
- [iOS SDK](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/docs/ios-sdk-overview): Integrate Branch deep linking and attribution into native iOS apps.
- [Android SDK](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/docs/android-sdk-overview): Integrate Branch into Android apps for linking and measurement.
- [Web SDK](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/docs/web-sdk-overview): Add Branch link handling and attribution to websites and web apps.
- [React Native SDK](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/docs/react-native-sdk-overview): Use Branch in React Native applications for deep linking and attribution.
- [Flutter SDK](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/docs/flutter-sdk-overview): Integrate Branch into Flutter apps across iOS and Android.
- [Unity SDK](https://help.branch.io/developers-hub/docs/unity-sdk-overview): Add Branch support to Unity-based mobile applications.

## Implementation Guides
- [Basic Integration](https://help.branch.io/docs/basic-integration): Core setup steps for enabling Branch in an app or website.
- [Link Data and Deepviews](https://help.branch.io/docs/deepviews): Configure Deepviews and link data for deferred deep linking experiences.
- [Advanced Deep Linking](https://help.branch.io/docs/advanced-deep-linking): Implement advanced routing, parameters, and user journey handling.
- [Events and Conversion Tracking](https://help.branch.io/docs/events-overview): Track user actions and conversion events with Branch.
- [Testing and Validation](https://help.branch.io/docs/testing-and-validation): Validate Branch links, app routing, and attribution behavior before launch.
- [Troubleshooting](https://help.branch.io/docs/troubleshooting): Diagnose common integration issues across Branch products and SDKs.

## Data, Analytics, and Integrations
- [Data Feeds](https://help.branch.io/docs/data-feeds): Export Branch attribution and event data to external systems.
- [Partner Integrations](https://help.branch.io/docs/partner-integrations): Connect Branch with ad networks, analytics, and marketing platforms.
- [Postbacks](https://help.branch.io/docs/postbacks): Configure postbacks for partners and campaign measurement workflows.
- [Events Overview](https://help.branch.io/docs/events-overview): Understand Branch event taxonomy, tracking, and downstream usage.
- [Audience and Engagement Data](https://help.branch.io/docs/engagement-builder): Use engagement and audience features to activate user journeys.
